facts.value: Ending a job requires uploading a completed I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation. Starting a new job or adding an additional job requires uploading a completed I-983 (pgs. 1-4). Changes in current employment, such as employer name, EIN, address, hours, compensation, job responsibilities, training plan, supervisor, and job title/role require an updated I-983 depending on the situation.
Students may have multiple jobs while on STEM OPT, as long as all conditions of the STEM OPT employment criteria are met.
Each job must be related to the major area of study, at least 20 hours a week, with a company that participates in E-Verify, and it must be a paid position.
